name: Houetsu
source:
「One who is everywhere and rules everything under the heavens. That’s what it means to be『King』, right? 」

She is a freeloader under [url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kouu[/url]'s care, with a large gang of thieves capable of rivaling an army. A worldly woman. 

Her academic language and calm demeanor may deceive, but she conceals her aggressive nature as the leader of a ring of thieves. 

Following the conflict between [url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kouu[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url], she went neutral, assisting [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url], who was clearly vanquished, in maintaining the balance between the two armies and strengthening the might of her own army behind the scenes.
